column1: # Profile corpus expectations. One row per measured line.
#   path           path under tree/, forward slashes; the first segment is the
#                  language directory and so the recall family
#   line           1-based line number in that file
#   expect         NONE, or one or more rule ids joined by |
#   justification  why that line expects that outcome
# A row naming rule ids is a positive: the profile must report one of them on
# that line. A NONE row is a negative: anything reported there counts against
# the reporting rule's row in noise/limits.tsv, which defaults to zero.
# Unlike the detection corpus there are no credential markers here: profile
# examples are ordinary code and are committed verbatim, so the snippet in
# tree/ is byte-identical to the rule matrix's positive_example or
